name: Milton / North York
description: A Milton/Meadowvale–North York family with historical Finch and York Mills variants and selected Meadowvale Business Park trips.

timeline.event: GO added a Milton / Streetsville–York Mills service, an early corridor predecessor.
The table documents 27 and 27A/B/D/E/F serving distinct Finch, York Mills and Meadowvale patterns.
The table uses Milton GO and Derry / Ninth Line in place of the older Main / Martin and Derry / Winston Churchill timepoints.

sources.title: 50 Years of GO Transit Bus Operations — historical chronology by Adam Zhelka / Toronto Transportation Society
GO table 27, printed effective 28 June 2008 (filename dated 3 December)
Metrolinx GO Transit Ridership Report, September 2016 (original report, archived by Steve Munro)
GO Milton / North York table 27, effective 5 January 2019

gaps: The number 27 adoption date is unknown.
The 2008 business-park variants 27A/E/F are documented but not individually reconstructed here; dated GTFS can supplement them.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
